sourceEvidence.title: Senior Staff Semiconductor RF Test Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related field with 14 years of related experience; Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related field with 12 years of experience; PhD in Electrical Engineering or closely related field with 9 years of experience
* Direct semiconductor test software and hardware development experience
* Prior test lead or test architect experience, working on developing production test solutions
* Direct experience in leading a team of test or product engineers, responsible for talent development and training
* Hands-on hardware skills including probe card and package part fixture/DIB design & coordinating layout & assembly
* Software skills in a modern language such as C#, Python, C++ or Java
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance is required
